scope: Local recorded availability audit for one frozen policy, no context backfill and no inference.

additional_evidence.interpretation: These saved manager outputs are later evidence; historical outputs are not required for an explicitly reconstructed counterfactual.

conclusion: No scanned news/fact row records availability on or before the original test end.
limitations: Counts include repeated rows across snapshots and are not independent or deduplicated news counts.
Live source files can change during the scan; each listed SHA256 identifies the exact bytes actually inspected.
This audit does not rule out an external archive reconstruction. Archive vintage/index time must be recorded separately from local receipt time.
Search is exhaustive for the listed patterns, not every arbitrary JSON file in the repository.
